brief:
Today, 11 November, is Pull A. Your Push A from 9 November landed in the log, and it moved the program in one place.

What changed: Push A's lateral raise slot is now the dumbbell lateral raise in its own name, three sets of 12 to 15, starting at 12.5. The slot was named for a machine, and on 28 October and again on 9 November you logged it as dumbbells (12.5 for 14, 13, 13 on 9 November); the card asked for 15 for 12 under the machine name and you took 12.5. Side delt sets do not change. I chose the dumbbells over a cable raise because that is what you actually train and the cable raise on Pull A has sat at 10 lb since July.

How Push A went, all logged live: smith incline press 155 for 8, then 175 for 8, 8, 8, four sets at 8, which earns 180 next Push A (160 for 8, then 180 for 6, 6, 6). Machine chest press 135 for 10, then 150 for 10, 10, exactly the card; it holds at 150. Cable crossover 12.5 for 14, 14, 14, still 12.5 and chasing 15. Reverse pec deck 90 for 15, 15, 15, all three at the top of the range, which earns the next step up the next time it comes up (the step size at this gym is not in the log, so write the weight you take in the note). Chest dips at bodyweight 10, 11, 11; 12 on all three earns more.

Tonight, Pull A, in pounds. Deadlift: 225 for 5, then 240 for 5, 5, 5; you did 205, 225, 235, 240 for 5 on 2 November, and the last three sets at 6 earn 250. Wide lat pulldown: 120 for 9 on all three sets. Seated cable row: 105 for 11 on all four sets (four sets stay; write a note if you would rather carry three). Dumbbell curl: 30 for 10 on all three; if all three reach 10 it earns 35, and if Pull A ends at 30 with any set under 10 the curl is swapped for the preacher curl tomorrow morning. Cable hammer curl: 42.5 for 12 on all three. Face pulls: 32.5 for 13, two sets. Cable lateral raise: 10 for 13, 13. After Pull A comes Legs A, then Push B.

Open questions: whether the last Push B slot (the one you logged as "Overhead db press", 50 for 12, 12) was triceps or a press, one word settles it; and the Legs A crunch that read "Plank" on 3 November. Your logs through 9 November are still stamped Meso 3, week 7, while the calendar says week 3 of the restarted block; if the phase tag at the top of the app is locked, the 25 November deload will not start by itself, and "Automatic (by date)" clears it. No bodyweight is logged since 23 August (207 lb); your 9 November Push A had none. Conditioning: 2 to 3 low-intensity sessions of 20 to 30 minutes a week are allowed in the build block; nothing extra is asked tonight.

Logs through 9 November are stamped Meso 3, week 7, which matches a phase tag locked to Meso 3; a lock would stop the 25 November deload starting by itself.
No bodyweight logged since 23 August (207 lb); a morning weigh-in this week would anchor the block.

block.why: Today is the fifteenth day of the block restarted on 28 October at the New York gym (week 3 of 4); it builds to 24 November, deload runs 25 November to 1 December, assessment 2 to 8 December, prep from 9 December, show 110 days away. New since yesterday: one night, Push A on 9 November, 45 minutes, 19 sets, every set logged live. It is the first Push A since 28 October, and it is the first night in this restart where the top lift hit the top of its range on every set (smith incline press 8 on all four sets). Nothing else has been logged since the 10 November review, so every other lift and muscle below repeats yesterday's reading and says so. The week of 9 to 15 November has Push A done; chest is at 13 of 18 so far, which is a half-finished week and not a shortfall. The program changes in one place today (the Push A lateral raise slot, version 9). It has changed often since the 28 October restart (versions 5 to 9, seven changes, five of them slot swaps or removals, each made so a card matches what was logged), and session totals have not risen: 19, 21, 20, 20, 21, 20. Still dated: the dumbbell curl on 12 November (swap to the preacher curl if Pull A ends at 30 lb with any set under 10 reps). Closed today: the Push A lateral raise slot. Next boundary is the deload on 25 November; the prep block is written at the assessment from what these four weeks log.

chest.why: Eighteen on paper, 13 on Push A and 5 on Push B, at the ceiling. The week of 26 October closed at 14 and the week of 2 to 8 November at 5, because Push A did not run that week; Push A ran on 9 November and the week now under way stands at 13 with Push B still to come. Push A on 9 November, live: smith incline press 155 for 8 then 175 for 8, 8, 8; machine chest press 135 for 10 then 150 for 10, 10; cable crossover 12.5 for 14, 14, 14; chest dips 10, 11, 11. Push B ran in full on 4 November (machine chest press 135 for 10, then 150 for 10, 10). Every chest lift did what its card asked or better, so the sets hold. The four-week average done is 8: it runs from the week of 19 October, which was Vancouver and a different gym, to the week now under way, which holds one night; it counts half credit, so compare it with the 18 on paper.

The incline press is the lift that moved: 155 for 8 then 175 for 8, 8, 8 on 9 November, live, up from 175 for 6 on 28 October. The shoulder press is unchanged since 4 November (50 for 8, 8, 8, 8 after 45 for 8, 10, 10, 10 on 31 October; Chennai had 50 for 10, 10, 10 on 12 October and 55 for 8, 9 on 15 October, so 50 for 8s is below your own best, and it holds at 50). The four-week average done is 6.9: it runs from the week of 19 October, which was Vancouver and a different gym, to the week now under way, which holds one night; it counts half credit, so compare it with the 15 on paper.

deadlift.why: A barbell weighs the same at every gym, so this is the one lift whose numbers compare across the whole log. On 2 November at New York: 205, 225, 235, 240 for 5, four sets, logged live three to four minutes apart, against a card that asked 235 on all four. That is the third visit up in a row since the sick Singapore night: 225 for 6 on 8 October, 235 for 5, 5, 5 at Vancouver on 23 October (three sets), 240 for 5 now, and the first four-set deadlift since 8 October. August was heavier (255 for 6, 6 on 18 August, 265 for 5, 5 on 28 August), and the gap is the road back. The dossier says regressing against the trailing median; that median is the August nights, and the direction since October is up. Next Pull A: 225 for 5, then 240 for 5, 5, 5; the last three sets at 6, the top of the range, earn 250. Nothing new has been logged on this lift since this was written, so tonight's number repeats it.

lat-pulldown-wide.why: First New York number, 2 November, logged live about two minutes apart: 105 for 10, then 120 for 8, 8, exactly the card, and 120 for 8 is the bottom of the 8 to 10 range. The card said to go to 135 if 105 was clearly easy; you did not, so 120 is the working weight on New York’s nights so far. 18 August, no gym on the log, was 150 for 9, 9; whether that was this stack is not in the log. Vancouver on 23 October was 105, 110, 120 for 9, 9, 8 on a different stack. Next Pull A: 120 for 9 on all three; three sets at 10 earn 127.5. Nothing new has been logged on this lift since this was written, so tonight's number repeats it.

seated-cable-row-wide.why: First New York number, 2 November, logged live about two and a half minutes apart: 105 for 10, 10, 10, 10, every set exactly the bottom of the 10 to 12 range, with the note “Why four sets?”. The card asked 12 and you got 10 on every set, the bottom of the range, with nothing falling off. 28 August, no gym on the log, was 105 for 12 on all four. If that was this machine, you are two reps a set under August at the same weight; if not, 105 is simply a working weight here. The four sets stay for now: the row went to four on 1 August so the back day rows at least as much as it curls (six biceps sets on Pull A, against this row, the wide pulldown and the deadlift’s half credit), and whether that leaves the upper back at its floor (direct count, eight of eight) or over its ceiling (weighted count, 19.5 against 16) is the counting rule decided on 10 November: targets stay and the fourth set stays. If you would rather carry three now, write it in the note. Next Pull A: 105 for 11 on all four; four sets at 12 earn 112.5. Nothing new has been logged on this lift since this was written, so tonight's number repeats it.
